scenarios.title: 1. Verify 'UNIFIED DIFF' label shows 'No diff loaded' when textarea is empty
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that when no diff text is present, the diff label shows the exact pre-change message 'No diff loaded' to indicate no content is loaded yet.

scenarios.title: 2. Verify 'Clear diff' button is disabled when no diff text present
scenarios.purpose: Check that the 'Clear diff' button is disabled if the unified diff textarea is empty, matching the pre-change behavior where clearing is only enabled when there is diff text.
